observedFailure: The EFFECT_THEN_MARKER transition incremented effectCount without a finite abstraction bound. Breadth-first exploration therefore generated an unbounded family of states until Node reached its approximately 4 GB heap limit.
whyThisInvalidatesTheRun: The preregistration explicitly defined a finite receiver state machine and full fixed-point enumeration. An unbounded counter violates that model boundary, so the aborted run cannot adjudicate any protocol.
permittedCorrection: Replace each effectCount increment with min(2, effectCount + 1). Values 0, 1, and 2 encode no effect, exactly one effect, and at least two effects; R1 depends only on that partition. No transition, invariant, protocol, threshold, or expected verdict may otherwise change.
preservationRule: Retain this record alongside the amended preregistration and all later results.
